statement: Inactive support is S minus active_support(W).
assumptions: W has finite support S and active support A
conclusion: A inactive coordinate is outside A

statement: Inactive coordinates do not affect selected payload carriers under the active support contract.
assumptions: All payload dependency coordinates are included in A
conclusion: Restricting to A preserves payload carriers
caveat: Does not prove arbitrary status locality.

statement: Certificate payload coordinates are preserved when certificate fields are declared active.
assumptions: Certificate dependency extraction is complete for selected fields

statement: Inactive coordinates do not affect counterexample status only if status dependencies, status domain, and normal form are invariant.
assumptions: Status semantics local to active fields;domain invariant;normal form transfers
conclusion: W and W_active have same status

statement: Removing inactive coordinates and renormalizing preserves support normal form.
assumptions: W normal and restriction to A is defined
caveat: Needed before status theorem can be applied.

statement: Recognized family-chain source form is preserved if recognizer/lift fields are active.
assumptions: Recognizer/lift fields are included in A

statement: If inactive irrelevance fails, the failure is named.
assumptions: Some payload/status/normal/source dependency is not proved irrelevant
conclusion: Failure is operation blocker or deferred higher-support candidate
active_support_definition_used: active support insufficient or dependency extraction incomplete
caveat: Failure is not hidden as preservation.

statement: Inactive-support irrelevance is payload-proved and status-domain-open.
conclusion: Payload side proved; status side proof-ready/open
